_doc: Complexity ladder L2 (the L1 twisted bend with a 50 % area coarctation at the isthmus (throat 15 mm past the bend end, 30 mm long)); the U-bend gallery mesh configuration with 18 cells across the span. Invoke with: python run_patient.py ladder_L2 --config cases_input/ladder_L2/config_gallery_mid_span18.json

case_info.description: Ladder L2: the L1 twisted bend with a 50 % area coarctation at the isthmus (throat 15 mm past the bend end, 30 mm long); 18 cells across the inlet span
case_info.source: OpenCardioFlow complexity ladder, 23 Nov 2026; cases_input/ubend/config_gallery_*.json with the geometry and inflow changed

geometry._doc: reference_radius_strategy='max' (default) anchors the background-mesh sizing to the largest vessel. For the single-tube ubend this is the inlet (27.4 mm). On a multi-branch aorta, switch to 'min' if you need every branch resolved to the cells_across_span target.
